description: Build a timed meeting agenda — add items with durations, get total time, then copy or download the agenda as text.

faqs.a: Each item has a title, an owner (optional), and a duration in minutes. Add as many as you like.
faqs.q: What goes into an agenda item?

faqs.a: The tool totals all durations and shows the meeting length live as you edit.
Yes — remove any item with its ✕ button; the total updates instantly.
